scene: egocentric (head-mounted) view of a person folding a garment on a table/work-surface

items.label: No engagement
items.desc: hands never engage the garment / the folding task never actually starts
items.fail_if: the hands never touch or manipulate a garment

items.label: Borderline fold
items.desc: awkward, unstable, partial, or barely-completed fold
items.fail_if: the fold is sloppy, partial, fumbled, or only barely works

items.label: Off task
items.desc: looking away from the workspace, idle, talking to people, or using a phone
items.fail_if: the person looks away from the work-surface, sits idle, talks to someone, or handles a phone

items.label: Occluded
items.desc: hands or garment blocked from view (hair, body, an object)
items.fail_if: hair, the body, or an object blocks the hands or garment for much of the clip

items.label: Incomplete
items.desc: truncated or interrupted before the fold is finished
items.fail_if: the clip cuts off or is interrupted before the fold completes
